People analytics: from one person's warning signs to a pattern

People analytics

One person's warning signs tell you about one person. People analytics looks across everyone.

People analytics means using employee data, such as exit records, surveys and reviews, to find problems early instead of guessing after people have left.

Try it

The difference is when you find out. Switch between the two.

Two numbers to know

Not all exits are the same. The early ones cost the most.

Turnover rate

Everyone who leaves over a set period, usually a year.

Early turnover

Only people who leave soon after they're hired. In this externship, "early" means the first 90 days.

1 in 3of Amazon's 2021 new hires stayed 90 days or more

Leaked Amazon research, unconfirmed by Amazon. Engadget, 2022 (opens in a new tab)

Try it

Read these 8 lines. Which problem comes up most?

Made-up lines for practice, not real reviews.

  • "Rate goes up every peak season and nobody explains why."Productivity
  • "My manager has never once said my name."Belonging
  • "After four 10-hour shifts I sleep through my days off."Burnout
  • "We're always short, so I'm expected to hit rate at two stations."Productivity
  • "Nobody on my team talks to me at break."Belonging
  • "I asked about moving up twice. Never heard back."Other
  • "Miss rate once and you get written up."Productivity
  • "The pace is brutal when you're new, and no one shows you the tricks."Productivity

How you'll use this

One complaint is a clue. The same complaint from many people is a pattern a manager can fix.
